key_facts.answer: From India to the UAE you need an ISO microchip, a valid rabies vaccination, an export No-Objection Certificate (NOC) from India's Animal Quarantine & Certification Service (AQCS), and a MOCCAE import permit arranged before travel. Compliant pets are not quarantined in the UAE.

sections.heading: The India side — the AQCS NOC
paragraphs: Exporting a pet from India runs through the Animal Quarantine & Certification Service (AQCS), which issues the export NOC, alongside your pet's microchip and rabies records. The NOC has its own lead time — confirm the current AQCS process before booking.

sections.heading: The UAE side — the import permit
paragraphs: The UAE requires a MOCCAE import permit (before travel), the microchip and a valid rabies vaccination; compliant pets aren't quarantined. Confirm permit timing and your breed against the UAE restricted list — full detail on the Moving to Dubai hub.

story.lead: On India → Dubai, the trap is two permits with separate clocks.
story.problem: An owner books a quick move assuming the documents are a formality.
story.mistake: The AQCS export NOC and the MOCCAE import permit are started too late and don't align with the flight.
story.discovery: Each permit has its own process and timing.
story.result: The flight shifts while both permits catch up.
story.lesson: Start both permits first; the paperwork sets the schedule, not the flight.

faqs.q: What's the key document from India?
faqs.a: The export NOC from AQCS, plus microchip and rabies records. Confirm the current AQCS process — it has its own lead time.

faqs.q: Will my pet be quarantined in the UAE?
faqs.a: No — with a valid MOCCAE import permit, microchip and rabies vaccination, pets aren't quarantined on arrival. Confirm current MOCCAE rules.
It's a short flight, so transit is brief, but the timeline is set by the two permits, not the flight time. Start them early.

verified_100pct.fact: UAE import (MOCCAE): permit valid 90 days; permanent microchip matching the cert; rabies ≥21 days (first/lapsed dose, none for a valid booster); titre only from high-risk countries (≥0.5 IU/ml, valid 365d); min age 12wk (low-risk)/15wk (high-risk); internal+external parasite doses within 14 days; max 2 pets/person/year; fees AED 200 permit, AED 500/dog & AED 250/cat release; no quarantine if compliant
